# CO01 package brief

Version: 1.1
Status: evidence-mapped production artifact

## Purpose
Build an educational name-control inventory without giving legal advice.

## Governing question
Who owns the label name, marks, domains, handles, likeness and archive authority?

## Evidence spine
S28; S29; S30; S32

## Claim or field architecture
Distinct IP tools have distinct scope; identity assets require verified ownership

## Production outputs
Flagship article; name-system diagram; five shorts; database walkthrough; counsel-prep inventory

## Release gate
No legal conclusion, jurisdictional promise or copied WIPO assessment.

## Accessibility and rights
Captions, transcripts, keyboard behavior, visible labels, exact canonical records, and object-level implementation decisions are mandatory.
